problem_solved: Affordable management of bud rot, stem canker, and soil-borne diseases in crops.
description: Technology on Trichoderma coir pith cake production is simple and low- cost technology with a shelf life of one year. This formulation is very easy to handle and apply in the crowns of coconut palms as a prophylactic treatment against bud rot and in the management of stem canker of cocoa and also for the management of soil-borne diseases in potted plants.
applications:
Biopesticide and agricultural bio-input manufacturers
Coconut, cocoa, and plantation crop cultivation enterprises
Organic farming and sustainable agriculture initiatives
Nursery, greenhouse, and potted plant production units
Agricultural extension agencies and farmer producer organizations (FPOs)
